payload.unit_title: R21 Seminar Workspace View and Print Summary (M2.5)
payload.objective: Perform a read-only architectural analysis of the R21 Seminar frontend workspace and print summary migration and produce an implementation-ready decomposition that preserves CampusLynk existing design system while replacing the legacy 2,171-line and 680-line monolithic views.
payload.explicit_request: Review the read-only architectural analysis for task 'M2.5-ANALYZE-001'. Confirm whether the decomposition, design system compliance, component mappings, sub-500-line modular structure, and two-slice implementation plan are approved, and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Slice 1 (M2.5-IMPLEMENT-001). Return decision: 'TASK_DISPATCH' with payload.task_dispatch.

task_report.summary: Read-only architectural analysis completed for M2.5. Legacy 2,171-line classroom view and 680-line print view mapped into 5 functional tabs, 5 modals, and 3 print modes. 100% mapped to existing <x-ui.*> components, <x-layouts.workspace-layout>, and <x-layouts.report-layout>. Decomposed into 15 modular Blade files, all strictly under 350 lines. All 6 endpoints reconciled against M2.4. Proposed 2-slice implementation plan with Slice 1 (M2.5-IMPLEMENT-001) as first concrete task.

tests.regressions: Zero changes made to application code or database

payload.reason: The M2.5 read-only analysis is approved as implementation-ready. The legacy 2,171-line virtual classroom and 680-line print view have been decomposed into a bounded 15-file structure with every proposed Blade artifact below the mandatory 500-line ceiling. The functional inventory covers all five workspace tabs, five modal workflows, three statutory print modes, shared print elements, and the relevant M2.4 backend endpoints. The proposed architecture correctly mounts the virtual classroom in <x-layouts.workspace-layout> and the print surface in <x-layouts.report-layout>, while mapping tables, modals, cards, tabs, buttons, inputs, selects, badges, alerts, and icons to existing <x-ui.*> infrastructure. No duplicate UI infrastructure or custom shell is authorized. The analysis also correctly separates workspace and print concerns while identifying reusable print partials. Slice 1 is appropriately limited to Blade structure and presentation migration; verification is isolated into Slice 2. The analysis was read-only and introduced no repository, database, or safety-boundary changes. Slice 1 may therefore proceed under the exact 15-file whitelist, with no expansion into controllers, routes, models, migrations, tests, or unrelated units.

task_dispatch.objective: Implement the approved R21 Seminar workspace and print Blade architecture by replacing the two monolithic legacy views with 15 modular, sub-500-line Blade files using the existing CampusLynk master shells and global UI components.
instructions: Create the approved workspace root at resources/views/r21_seminar/virtual_classroom_seminar.blade.php using <x-layouts.workspace-layout>.

Create the approved workspace partials: stats-strip.blade.php, tab-evaluation.blade.php, tab-schedule.blade.php, tab-consolidated.blade.php, tab-attainment.blade.php, tab-rubrics.blade.php, modals.blade.php, and scripts.blade.php.
Create the approved print root at resources/views/r21_seminar/seminar_report_print.blade.php using <x-layouts.report-layout> with the appropriate landscape orientation.
Create the approved print partials: print/header.blade.php, print/signatures.blade.php, print/consolidated.blade.php, print/cia-submission.blade.php, and print/schedule.blade.php.
Preserve the functional behavior and data contracts identified in the analysis while adapting presentation to the existing CampusLynk design system.
Reuse existing <x-ui.*> components wherever applicable; do not recreate buttons, cards, modals, tables, tabs, badges, inputs, selects, alerts, icons, or shell infrastructure.
Preserve the six M2.4 backend endpoint contracts and use the existing route/controller behavior rather than introducing new endpoints.

Preserve all five workspace tabs, five modal workflows, three print modes, statutory rubric information, grading presentation, attainment presentation, and relevant syllabus/schedule/evaluation interactions.
Keep every created Blade file strictly below 500 lines; target the analyzed sizes where practical.
Use modular includes/partials rather than duplicating markup across tabs or print modes.
Do not modify any controller, route, model, migration, service, database state, test, User.php, or migration control-plane file.
Do not add custom CSS or duplicate design tokens when existing CampusLynk styles/components can provide the required presentation.
constraints: STRICT WHITELIST: only the 15 approved Blade files under carmel-linx-laravel/resources/views/r21_seminar/ may be created or modified.
Do not modify models, migrations, services, tests, or database state.
All applicable UI elements MUST reuse existing <x-ui.*> components.
No raw table markup where <x-ui.table> is applicable.
No duplicate UI infrastructure or custom shell.
Every Blade file MUST remain strictly below 500 lines.
Do not expand scope into M2.6 or unrelated R21 features.
Do not commit changes; return the implementation TASK_REPORT only.
task_dispatch.expected_report: Report the exact 15 Blade files created/modified and their line counts; confirm workspace-layout and report-layout usage; enumerate each x-ui.* component reused; confirm all five tabs, five modals, and three print modes are represented; confirm M2.4 route/controller contracts were preserved; report Blade syntax validation and relevant test/regression results; identify any parity gaps or defects; confirm whitelist compliance, User.php safety boundary, and absence of database changes; include git status/diff summary without committing.
stop_conditions: Stop immediately if implementation requires modification of any file outside the 15-file whitelist.
Stop and report a defect if an M2.4 controller or route change appears necessary.
Stop if an existing global component cannot support a required behavior and do not create replacement UI infrastructure.
Stop if any Blade file reaches or exceeds 500 lines.
Do not modify database schema or execute migrations.
Return TASK_REPORT only after the approved Blade implementation is complete.
